objective: Build the shared UI components and the thirteen copied Lucide icons in frontend/src/components/ui/, as wiki/CodeContext/FrontendUI/components.md sections 2 and 3 specify, without using them in any feature yet.
acceptance_criteria: Button renders a native <button>, passes every prop through, and maps variant (primary, secondary, ghost) and size (md, sm) to the classes exported by its CSS module; buttonClass(variant, size) returns the same classes for use on a Link.
Button size md sets its minimum height with var(--target-min) (static check of the module CSS).
Card renders the element named by its as prop (article, section or div) with the card class.

InlineAlert renders a

and StatusLine a

whose text is the children; StatusLine accepts variant neutral or success; each leading icon is aria-hidden.
Badge variant live renders the visible word it is given plus an aria-hidden dot; variants neutral and outline render no dot.

GameScore renders the home score, an en dash and the away score in that order with the labels Home and Away; the game-state mapping in components.md section 4 holds for every listed code, and an unknown code is shown as given with no Live badge.
Avatar renders the first character of the username exactly as typed (not uppercased) and is aria-hidden.
EmptyState and Skeleton exist; Skeleton is aria-hidden and uses no animation.
Each of the thirteen icons in components.md section 3 renders an <svg aria-hidden="true"> drawn with currentColor, and src/components/ui/icons/LICENSE contains Lucide's ISC licence text.

Every *.module.css file this unit adds contains no hex, rgb(), hsl() or named colour, no px font size, and no outline: none or outline: 0 without a :focus-visible rule in the same file (a static test reads the files from disk).
Every existing test in the suite passes unchanged; no existing test file is edited.
